title: Mean Value Estimates for a Real-Exponent Analogue of Waring's Problem
summary: For non-integer $θ> 3$ and $κ\geq 1$, we show that the smallest $r_0$ such that the mean value estimate \[ \int_{-κ}^κ \Big| \sum_{X < x \leq 2X} e(αx^θ) \Big|^{2r} dα\ll_ε κX^{2r - θ+ε} \] holds for all integers $r \geq r_0$ satisfies $2r_0 \leq θ^2(1+O(θ^{-1/2}))$. This is an improvement over the previous bound by Poulias of $2r_0 \leq (\lfloor 2θ\rfloor + 1)(\lfloor 2θ\rfloor + 2)$.
